definitions.bangumi_yuri_ratio: audited 百合 tag count / (wish + collect + doing + on_hold + dropped)
definitions.bangumi_wiki_positive: audited 百合 membership in Bangumi wiki-maintained meta_tags
definitions.anilist_positive: Yuri tag rank > 0; rank is relevance, not users
definitions.common_coverage: attributable entries available in Bangumi, Anime-Planet, AniList, and MyAnimeList
definitions.unresolved_romance_explicitness: unknown is reported as a separate non-ordered group
definitions.relationship_aggregation: highest_romance_explicitness is the maximum across relationships[]; relationship heterogeneity is reported separately and is not an explicitness level
definitions.mainline_romance_explicitness: maximum romance_explicitness across female_female_relation=yes relationships with narrative_centrality=main; a complete woman-woman inventory with no mainline relation is non_romantic, while unavailable scope remains unknown
definitions.platform_positive_mainline_explicitness: distribution of mainline romance explicitness among works whose audited attributable entry is positive for that platform's target label; no_exact_entry and negative entries are outside the denominator
definitions.official_literal_yuri_gl: 是 = at least one manually reviewed official statement uses yuri or girls_love literally; 所核未见 = reviewed sources had no matching statement; 资料不足 = review was partial or unavailable
definitions.official_female_romance_wording: 是 = at least one manually reviewed official statement directly describes an explicit female-female romance or romantic direction; 所核未见 and 资料不足 retain the same evidence boundary
definitions.official_source_facets: scope and surface are multi-select membership facets of recorded official statements, not a list of every source checked
